headline: Advent Hotels International Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Advent Hotels International Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on completion of acquisition of balance 25% equity shareholding in BD&P Hotels (India) Private Limited and its becoming a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of…
detail: Acquisition - Advent Hotels International Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on completion of acquisition of balance 25% equity shareholding in BD&P Hotels (India) Private Limited and its becoming a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
